# CapabilityTrail

CapabilityTrail shows every capability and where it sits on the five stages: a ledger, a compact rail or a focus view of one capability.

`Pathwisse.CapabilityTrail` · Signature

## Use

```jsx
<Pathwisse.CapabilityTrail capabilities={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Pathwisse.CapabilityTrail" capabilities="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
